title: EFC — Grid-Higgs Framework
abstract: Introduces the Grid-Higgs Framework, which models spacetime as a dynamic grid whose structural nodes are Higgs-field excitations. In this entropic, energy-flow-based theory, dark matter effects arise from grid tension driven by entropy gradients and black holes are grid-collapse regions; the framework yields testable predictions for lensing, CMB high-ℓ spectra, and gravitational-wave propagation.
